newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close sharply higher, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close sharply higher, trade thin.

text.p: UK grain futures closed with wheat as much as 1.55 stg up on Monday after reaching 1.80 stg above Friday's close at one stage, but trade was thin.
"The volume doesn't match the movement," said one trader.
Wheat ended 1.55 to 0.15 stg, but turnover was only 239 lots. Barley finished 0.75 to 0.50 stg up after trading 32 lots.
Traders said matters were little better on the cash market with few offers seen on the fob or delivered markets.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract was unchanged and tradeless.
